title: Memory
subtitle: View and edit the agent's long-term memory files, and configure background consolidation so the agent keeps learning across sessions
enableHelp: When enabled, session archives are periodically distilled into the long-term memory files on schedule
cronHelp: 5-field cron expression, e.g. 0 3 * * * means daily at 03:00
retainDaysHelp: After a successful run, archives older than this are moved to archived/
maxMemoryKbHelp: Consolidation compresses the memory file when it exceeds this size
consolidationStarted: Consolidation started — this page refreshes when it finishes
filesHint: These files are injected into the system prompt when a new session starts; edits take effect in new sessions
